concept.title: Unleashed UI Customization Architecture
concept.description: The architectural map for the custom Unleashed Firefox theme.
concept.details: The Unleashed theme relies on Firefox's modern component architecture and global cascading via a `patches/` folder that mirrors `mozilla-central`. - Branding: Handled via Project Fluent (`brand.ftl`) to globally replace "Firefox" with "Unleashed". - Global Theme & Colors: Modified via `tokens-shared.css`, `browser-shared.css`, and `global-shared.css`. Changing root CSS variables here updates the entire UI. - Menu Layouts: Padding and borders adjusted in `menupanel.css` and `panelUI-shared.css`. - Rapid Deployment: Instead of running a 2-hour `mach build`, `live_patch_injector.py` injects patches directly into `/usr/lib/unleashed/` and clears the startupCache. - Known Bugs: The "Phantom Tab Pin Box" bug is fixed by applying `display: none !important;` to `#pinned-drop-indicator-text` and `#pinned-drop-indicator` in `tabs.css`.
